subject: french
title: French Hellos
welcome_lead: Bonjour, salut and how to say hi in French.
meta_desc: KS3 French: greetings, hello, goodbye, basic phrases.
final_note: Start every conversation with a confident bonjour.

concepts.def: Hello / good day (formal, anytime in day).

walkthroughs.body_html: Bonjour works any time of day with anyone — teacher, shopkeeper, stranger. It literally means 'good day'. Always use it first when entering a French shop.
Salut is the casual 'hi' used between friends and family. It can also mean 'bye'. Don't use it with adults you don't know — too informal.
The standard goodbye is au revoir. After dark say bonsoir for evening greeting and bonne nuit only when going to bed. A bientot = see you soon.
